meta.name: requesting-code-review
meta.description: Use when completing tasks, implementing major features, or before merging to verify work meets requirements

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理待合并的改动,发起代码审查并核对需求是否达标。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在完成任务或合并分支前想确认改动真的符合要求。
copy.tagline_en: Turn pending changes into a review request that checks against requirements.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to confirm changes meet requirements before merging.

howto.what: Claude 会派一个代码审查子代理，在你给出改动说明、需求和起止 commit SHA 后，返回优点、按 Critical/Important/Minor 分级的问题和评估结论；它只拿到这些上下文，不带入你的会话历史。
howto.when: 在子代理驱动开发中每个任务完成后、完成大功能后、合并到 main 前触发审查；卡住、重构前或修完复杂 bug 后也可按需选用。

say.text: 审查 Task 2 的改动是否符合 docs 里的计划再继续
say.note: 把需求和起止 SHA 一起交给审查者

say.text: 先把审查结果里的 Important 问题修掉，再往下做
say.note: Critical 立即修，Minor 记下来

howto.what_en: Claude dispatches a code-review subagent with crafted context (description, requirements, base/head SHAs) and gets back strengths, issues graded Critical/Important/Minor, and an assessment — never your session history.
howto.when_en: Triggered after each task in subagent-driven development, after a major feature, and before merging to main; also optional when stuck, before refactoring, or after fixing a complex bug.

say_en.text: Dispatch a code reviewer for this change: BASE_SHA is HEAD~1, HEAD_SHA is HEAD
say_en.note: Reviewer returns graded issues and an assessment

say_en.text: Review Task 2's diff against the plan before I move on
say_en.note: Pass requirements and SHAs to the reviewer

say_en.text: Fix the Important findings before continuing
say_en.note: Critical fixed now, Minor noted for later
